verdict.rationale: Drata's API documents control-to-requirement mappings: listing requirements per control, resetting mappings, comparing control requirements, and listing frameworks and their requirements. This implies one control can map to requirements across multiple frameworks. The evidence is only endpoint names, though, with no description of SOC 2 work automatically counting toward ISO 27001 or HIPAA. missing for 10: explicit documentation that one control or evidence item satisfies multiple frameworks automatically, a named SOC 2 to ISO 27001/HIPAA crosswalk, a UI or report showing framework overlap, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown
